notes: HEVC/VP9 12bit use P016/Y216/Y416 with the least significant 4 bits set to zero.

Before vaapi version(1.9.0), media driver only allow to create 16bit surface for 12bit bitstream decoding, padding bits will be filled with 0 by hardware. After 1.9.0 vaapi version, media driver is supported to create both 12bit and 16bit surface for 12bit bitstream decoding.
